description: This Java source file defines an abstract class EventBusCredentialsManagementAdapter that binds a CredentialsManagementService to the Vert.x event bus, facilitating credential management operations for an Eclipse Hono-based system. It includes methods for processing get and update requests, decoding credentials from JSON payloads, and managing tracing spans.

classes.name: EventBusCredentialsManagementAdapter
classes.description: An abstract adapter class that binds the CredentialsManagementService to the Vert.x event bus, handling credential-related messages such as get and update operations.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the CredentialsManagementService instance.

methods.name: getEventBusAddress
methods.description: Returns the address on the event bus where this adapter listens for messages.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Routes incoming event bus messages based on their operation type (get, update, or custom).

methods.name: processCustomCredentialsMessage
methods.description: Handles unsupported or custom operation requests, defaulting to a 400 Bad Request error.

methods.name: processUpdateRequest
methods.description: Processes update credential requests, decoding the payload and forwarding to the credentials service.

methods.name: decodeCredential
methods.description: Decodes a credential from a JSON object based on its type.

methods.name: decodeCredentials
methods.description: Decodes a list of credentials from a JSON array.

methods.name: credentialsFromPayload
methods.description: Extracts credentials from the event bus message payload.

methods.name: processGetRequest
methods.description: Handles get credential requests, retrieving credentials from the service and creating a response.
